stories.headline: Meta Lab opens its first Chicago location
stories.subtitle: Meta's first Midwest store is coming to Rush Street in Chicago, bringing hands-on demos of the Display glasses and the rest of the lineup to the Windy City just in time for the holidays — a new flagship shoppers may ask about.

stories.headline: Meta's own gift guide puts Ray-Ban Display front and center
stories.subtitle: Meta's Best Gifts for 2026 guide names Meta Ray-Ban Display one of the best tech gifts of the year, alongside Quest and the rest of the glasses lineup. Expect holiday shoppers asking what's worth gifting this season.

stories.headline: Oprah picks Meta Glasses Adventurer as a Favorite Thing for 2026
stories.subtitle: Oprah named Meta Glasses Adventurer one of her Favorite Things for 2026, calling out the $249 starting price. Expect gift shoppers to ask about it — it's the most mainstream gift-guide nod Meta's glasses have had yet.

stories.headline: Disney+ brings 3D movies to Quest — and Meta VR Glasses next spring
stories.subtitle: Disney+ subscribers can now stream more than 60 movies in 3D on Meta Quest, with immersive environments too — and Meta says the same 3D experience is coming to Meta VR Glasses when they launch in spring 2027.

stories.headline: Muse gets Spaces: build custom mini-apps by describing an idea
stories.subtitle: Meta's new Spaces feature lets Muse build custom mini-apps from a plain-language idea — gift trackers, planners, games — that stay updated from connected apps. It's live now everywhere Muse is available.
